notes: Taken from the Board of Elections' 46-day election notice, which lists every contest and issue with the precincts that vote on it and gives the full ballot wording of each issue, checked against the Board's sample ballots for all 69 precinct splits. The notice leaves out the State Senate (1st District) and Court of Appeals races, which are taken from the sample ballots.

Candidates are listed alphabetically by last name, not in ballot order: Ohio rotates the order of names from precinct to precinct. Certified write-in candidates are not printed on the ballot and are not listed.

"Where you live" uses the state voter file: a district or school levy is shown for a city, village or township when any of its voters live in that district. Your exact ballot depends on your precinct.
The Board's notice does not give local issue numbers.

issues.title: County sales and use tax: renewal of 0.5% for 5 years for permanent improvements
issues.text: The Board of County Commissioners of Logan County proposes to levy a sales and use tax in the amount of 0.5% for the purpose of providing additional revenue for the general fund for the acquisition, construction, equipping or repairing of a class or group of permanent improvements, to wit 25% for the county roads and bridges and storm water improvements limited to the right of way, 25% for use by the Sheriff for safety forces services and equipment, infrastructure of permanent improvements to service and protect the safety of all Logan County, 20% for township, roads and bridges and stormwater improvements within the right of way, 20% for city and village roads and bridges and stormwater within the right of way and 10% for economic development and land use planning for a period of 5 years. Shall the resolution of the Logan County Commissioners proposing the continuation of the current 0.5% sales and use tax be approved?

levy.estimate: $130,000 a year; $89 for each $100,000 of market value
